Leaders Participate in Gandhi Jayanti Cleanliness Campaigns

Across India, political leaders participated in cleanliness and plantation drives to commemorate Gandhi Jayanti. In Delhi, Minister Sood led a sanitation and plantation campaign. In Panipat, BJP State President Dr. Archana Gupta and Education Minister Mahipal Dhanda participated in a labor donation drive as part of the 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyan' to promote a message of cleanliness through public participation. Separately, CM Rekha took part in a cleanliness campaign.
